necessary_context.content: Section 1 studies minimization over a geodesically convex X in a Hadamard manifold. Use the Hadamard setting, with sectional curvature bounded below by kappa<=0, for the selected projected results. Section 2.3 assumes an attained minimizer x* in X. Section 3 assumes an exact nearest-point projection and diameter at most D. Lemma 7 supplies single-valued nonexpansive projection for closed convex X.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.1 Eq. (1) and footnote 1; p.5 section 2.3; p.6 section 3; p.8 Lemma 7
necessary_context.name: Problem and geometry

necessary_context.content: Definition 1 uses geodesic interpolation convexity and the tangent supporting inequality f(y)>=f(x)+<g_x,Log_x(y)>. Definition 3 defines L_f-Lipschitzness by |f(x)-f(y)|<=L_f d(x,y) for x,y in M. Do not replace this by an unspecified relative boundary subgradient convention on X.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.5 Definition 1 and following paragraph; p.6 Definition 3
necessary_context.name: Subgradient and Lipschitzness

necessary_context.content: zeta(kappa,c)=sqrt(|kappa|)c/tanh(sqrt(|kappa|)c). At zero argument use its continuous value 1. D denotes a diameter bound, not a radius.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.8 immediately before Corollary 8; p.10 discussion after Theorem 9
